name: open the pull request and post the plan on it
about: Push the branch and open the PR. Write the description first: what changed, why, and what has already been tested — it is the first thing every reader meets, and a PR without one costs each of them the same reconstruction. Then comment the plan onto it: `sb plugin plans show <plan> --markdown`, that ONE plan and never the store, posted as the markdown it gives you — no fenced block, no summarising, no reformatting. The whole record is the point: anyone reading the PR gets the state the lead has, rendered so they can actually read it. Nobody is asked whether to do any of this.
